SELECT * from BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES GROUP BY ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230510  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE ISLATEST = 1
--2515495
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230510
--2515495

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230510 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[BANK_ID]
,[ACID]
,[PREVIOUS_CURRBAL]
,[PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL]
,[CURRENT_EOD_DATE]
,[ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL]
,[ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230510; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE ISLATEST = 1 GROUP BY  ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE HAVING COUNT(1)>1;

--7

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
--251495
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230510
--251495
